WITH closure_calls AS (
  SELECT
    site_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS closure_call_count

  SELECT
    site_id,
    SUM(total_expense) AS total_expense_last_year
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.fct_cc_site_cost_monthly`
  WHERE month_start BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

)
SELECT
  d.site_id,
  d.site_name,
  d.operator,
  d.is_outsourced,
  c.closure_call_count,
  s.total_expense_last_year
FROM closure_calls c
JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_contact_center.dim_cc_site` d ON c.site_id = d.site_id

WITH OPEN_LOANS AS (
  SELECT
    PRODUCT_CODE,
    BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS N
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account`
  WHERE ACCOUNT_FAMILY = 'LOAN' AND IS_OPEN
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
DLQ AS (
  SELECT
    A.PRODUCT_CODE,
    A.BRANCH_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS D
  FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily` DD
  JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_account` A USING (ACCOUNT_KEY)
  WHERE DD.SNAPSHOT_DATE = (
    SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DATE) FROM `fennmoor-dw.dw_risk.fct_delinquency_daily`
  )
  AND DD.DPD >= 30
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  O.PRODUCT_CODE,
  B.BRANCH_NAME,
  O.N AS OPEN_LOANS,
  COALESCE(DLQ.D, 0) AS DELINQUENT_LOANS,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(DLQ.D, O.N) AS DELINQUENCY_RATE
FROM OPEN_LOANS O
LEFT JOIN DLQ USING (PRODUCT_CODE, BRANCH_ID)
LEFT JOIN `fennmoor-dw.dw_core.dim_branch` B ON B.BRANCH_ID = O.BRANCH_ID
ORDER BY DELINQUENCY_RATE DESC
